news.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Workday Following Earnings Report
news.summary: Several financial institutions, including Goldman Sachs, DA Davidson, Evercore ISI, TD Cowen, and Bernstein, updated their price targets for Workday on November 25, 2026, following the company's recent quarterly earnings release.

news.headline: Workday Reports Fiscal 2027 Third Quarter Financial Results
news.summary: Workday, Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2027, reporting total revenues of $2.705 billion, an 11.2% increase year-over-year.

news.headline: Motivosity Joins Workday Partner Program
news.summary: Employee recognition platform Motivosity has joined the Workday Partner Program to integrate its rewards and recognition tools with Workday Human Capital Management.

news.headline: Google Ends Commercial Agreement with Australia's ABC
news.summary: Alphabet's Google has terminated a commercial agreement with Australia's public broadcaster, the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC), as part of a broader retreat from media funding in the region.

news.headline: Malaysia Regulator Files Lawsuits Against Google Seeking $145.8 Million
news.summary: The Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission has initiated two lawsuits against Alphabet's Google, seeking $145.8 million in damages for alleged failures to remove harmful content from YouTube.

news.headline: Google Upgrades AI Search Mode with Consumer Spending Integration
news.summary: Google has announced an upgrade to its AI Search Mode, which now integrates consumer spending data to track expenditure details.

news.headline: Maverick Medical AI Integrates CodeAgent with Microsoft Dragon Copilot
news.summary: Maverick Medical AI is showcasing its CodeAgent documentation assistant within Microsoft's Dragon Copilot at RSNA 2026.

news.headline: Microsoft Declares 'Code Red' Following Historic Outage
news.summary: Microsoft has initiated a 'Code Red' mobilization to enhance its response to service disruptions following a significant outage earlier in November.

news.headline: Microsoft Secures 51MW Geothermal Energy Contract in New Zealand
news.summary: Microsoft has entered into a contract for 51MW of next-generation geothermal power in New Zealand to support its data center energy needs.
